I'm just starting my fitness journey, and looking for some advice.

My apartment complex has some basic equipment; (i don't know the names, apologies) treadmill, stair stepper, stationary bicycle, bench press, leg extender, some sort of multi press, and maybe a butterfly press.

I'm approximately 5'7", 200lbs; looking to lose weight and, if I'm being optimistic, gain a little definition. I'm a very precise person, and would have trouble making myself workout regularly without some sort of schedule.

I know very little about fitness. I was thinking of spending an hour in the evenings, Saturday through Wednesday, and alternating between cardio and lifting each day.

Any advice on how to tailor and schedule my works; which machines to use, how long, how many sets, which days, would be greatly appreciated.

A great place to start is exrx.net

There is a beginners page and a whole directory of exercises that can help you get started. There is also an FAQ on the sidebar here. I would advise looking at that and see if it answers your questions.

the wiki has some great information, including routines and you should take a look at it to get some of the basics down.

An apartment complex gym isn't the most ideal for strength training as they lack some of the better equipment like barbells and squat racks and we can't really build you a routine without knowing what equipment you have available.

I was in the same boat as you and only used an apartment gym for a few months and I decided to get a gym membership and hop on a real strength routine and that's when I saw the most results.
